description: This file defines a PHP class 'sysinfo' that extends 'bsd_common' and provides methods to gather system information specific to NetBSD, including network stats, device info, and system uptime.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A class providing system information for NetBSD systems, including network, device, and uptime details.

methods.name: sysinfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing regular expressions and setting up the object.

methods.name: get_sys_ticks
methods.description: Calculates system uptime in seconds based on kernel boot time.

methods.name: network
methods.description: Retrieves network interface statistics such as bytes, packets, errors, and drops.

methods.name: ide
methods.description: Extracts IDE device information, including model and capacity, from system messages.

methods.name: distroicon
methods.description: Returns the filename of the icon representing the NetBSD distribution.
